schemes.name: PM Scholarship for Central Armed Police Forces & Paramilitary Forces
schemes.description: To encourage higher technical and professional education for the dependent wards & widows of CAPFs & AR Personnel.
schemes.benefits: Scholarships up to Rs. 36000 per year for professional degree courses.
schemes.eligibility_summary: Dependent wards & widows of CAPFs & AR personnel who died in harness/election duty or disabled due to causes attributable to Government service.
schemes.application_steps:
Step 1: Visit National Scholarship Portal.
Step 2: Register as new user.
Step 3: Fill application form and upload documents.

schemes.name: Odisha Madhubabu Pension Yojana
schemes.description: Social security pension scheme for the elderly, widows, and persons with disabilities in Odisha.
schemes.department: Department of Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
schemes.benefits: Monthly pension of Rs. 500 to Rs. 900 depending on age and disability.
schemes.eligibility_summary: Resident of Odisha, minimum age 60 (or widow of any age / person with disability), family income below limit.
schemes.application_steps:
Step 1: Visit local BDO or municipality office.
Step 2: Submit filled form with documents.

schemes.name: PM KISAN Samman Nidhi
schemes.description: Income support to all landholding farmer families in the country.
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefits: Financial benefit of Rs. 6000 per year in three equal installments.
schemes.eligibility_summary: All landholding farmers' families, which have cultivable landholding in their names.
schemes.application_steps:
Step 1: Visit PM-Kisan Portal.
Step 2: Click on 'New Farmer Registration'.
Step 3: Fill details and submit.

schemes.name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
schemes.description: Scheme to address the declining Child Sex Ratio (CSR) and related issues of women empowerment over a life-cycle continuum.
schemes.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.benefits: Awareness and advocacy campaign, targeted multi-sectoral interventions.
schemes.eligibility_summary: Girl child up to age 10 for opening Sukanya Samriddhi account under this umbrella.
schemes.application_steps:
Step 1: Visit nearest Post Office or Bank for Sukanya Samriddhi Account.
Step 2: Submit required documents.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.description: Health insurance scheme providing health cover for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
schemes.department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.benefits: Health cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year.
schemes.eligibility_summary: Poor, deprived rural families and identified occupational categories of urban workers' families as per SECC 2011.
schemes.application_steps:
Step 1: Check eligibility on PMJAY portal using mobile number or ration card.
Step 2: Visit empanelled hospital or CSC for e-card generation.

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin
schemes.description: Housing for all in rural areas.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs. 1.30 lakh in hilly areas for construction of pucca house.
schemes.eligibility_summary: Houseless families or those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in rural areas.
schemes.application_steps:
Step 1: Beneficiary identified through Gram Sabha.
Step 2: Verification by block officials.
Step 3: Funds transferred directly to bank account.

schemes.name: National Scholarship Portal - Post Matric SC
schemes.description: Financial assistance to SC students studying at post matriculation or post-secondary stage.
schemes.benefits: Maintenance allowance, reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees.
schemes.eligibility_summary: SC students studying in recognized institutions, with family income up to Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum.
schemes.application_steps:
Step 1: Register on National Scholarship Portal.
Step 2: Submit application and upload necessary documents.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
schemes.description: Loans up to Rs. 10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
schemes.benefits: Collateral-free loans for income-generating activities in manufacturing, trading, and services.
schemes.eligibility_summary: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for a non-farm sector income generating activity.
schemes.application_steps:
Step 1: Prepare business plan.
Step 2: Approach nearest bank or microfinance institution.
Step 3: Fill Mudra loan application.

schemes.name: Odisha Kalia Yojana
schemes.description: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation for farmers in Odisha.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance for cultivation, livelihood support for landless agricultural households.
schemes.eligibility_summary: Small/marginal farmers and landless agricultural labourers of Odisha.
schemes.application_steps:
Step 1: Visit KALIA web portal or GP office.
Step 2: Fill the form (Green/Red) as applicable.
Step 3: Submit to Gram Panchayat.

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi
schemes.description: Micro-credit facility for street vendors to resume their livelihoods.
schemes.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.benefits: Working capital loan up to Rs. 10,000 to 50,000, subsidized interest rate.
schemes.eligibility_summary: Street vendors vending in urban areas.
schemes.application_steps:
Step 1: Visit PM SVANidhi portal.
Step 2: Click on 'Apply for Loan'.
Step 3: Verify mobile via OTP and submit details.

required_documents.notes: Must be linked to mobile number

schemes.name: Bihar Student Credit Card
schemes.description: Financial support to 12th pass students going for higher education.
schemes.benefits: Education loan up to Rs. 4 Lakhs at subsidized interest.
schemes.eligibility_summary: Resident of Bihar, age 25 or below, completed 12th standard, enrolled in recognized higher education course.
schemes.application_steps:
Step 1: Register on MNSSBY portal.
Step 2: Visit DRCC with original documents for verification.

schemes.name: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Uzhavar Urimai
schemes.description: Income support for farmers in Tamil Nadu.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance to support cultivation costs.
schemes.eligibility_summary: Farmers residing in Tamil Nadu with active land holdings.
schemes.application_steps:
Step 1: Contact local agricultural extension officer.
Step 2: Provide land chitta and adangal details.
